rationale_one_line: code-review-graph is a structural project (a knowledge graph for AI agents); OpenCode's monospace-on-cream identity matches the terminal-native register of the tool, and SCHEMATIC lets the diagram scene carry the thesis instead of words.
writing_tone_notes: Engineer-to-engineer. State the numbers, name the tradeoff. No marketing voice. Contractions where natural. Lower-case scene copy preserves the monospaced manpage feel of OpenCode chrome.
do_rules: Render every scene in JetBrainsMono (Berkeley Mono substitute).
Hold the cream canvas (#FDFCFC) and ink near-black (#201D1D). One blue accent, reserved.
Use the diagram scene as the visual hero — nodes and edges sell the project, not adjectives.
Let the close subtitle name a different angle (MIT, London) than the X caption.
dont_rules: Don't repeat star count, 49x, or the words 'blast radius' anywhere except where each is assigned.
Don't introduce a sans-serif body — OpenCode is one font.
Don't recycle any preset already in the last 14 history entries.
